title: Get Alert Details
description:
Returns details of an alert using its unique ID. As a member, you can only retrieve published alerts that are shared with you.

### Changelog


Returns scheduled_expiry_time and shared_by response parameters.
Returns the source_urls response parameter.
Returns the analyst_groups response parameter.
For analysts, access to the alert is based on the categories associated with your user role in the Analyst Portal. However, if your user role has View All Alerts permission, you can access all alerts based on your preference. This update does not impact credentials generated prior to this version.

path.name: short_id
path.description: Pass the 8-digit unique ID of the alert for which you want to retrieve the details. You can retrieve the alert ID using the **Get Alerts** endpoint.

body.name: short_id
body.description: Returns the 8-digit unique ID of the alert.

body.name: title
body.description: Returns the title of the alert.
body.value: New Malware Variant Targeting Enterprise Networks

body.name: content
body.description: Returns the description of the alert.
body.value: A newly discovered malware strain is actively exploiting vulnerabilities in enterprise networks, enabling unauthorized access and data exfiltration. Organizations are advised to update security measures, monitor network traffic, and apply patches to mitigate the threat.
